headline.maxWords.why: a flyer headline is 8 words or fewer; rewrite it, the body carries the rest

headline.maxChars.why: a flyer headline is 64 characters or fewer; rewrite it

body.maxWords.why: the body is 30 words or fewer: cut it, or move the rest to the event's other channels

body.maxChars.why: the body is 200 characters or fewer: cut it

date.required.why: a flyer without a date is not an event flyer yet; ask for the date, or make a poster

date.maxWords.why: the date is the day (and time), 4 words or fewer; reference the message fact

place.maxWords.why: the place is where to go, 6 words or fewer; the full address goes on the event page

cta.maxWords.why: a call to action is 3 words or fewer and starts with a verb ("Come say hello"); rewrite it

cta.maxChars.why: a call to action is 3 words or fewer and starts with a verb ("Come say hello"); rewrite it

kicker.maxWords.why: the kicker names the event or series, 4 words or fewer; rewrite it

logo.required.why: refuse to render; intake is incomplete
